+def _squash(lines: Iterable[str]) -> str:

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SentData:
+    """The data region of a request — what the model was actually shown —
+    prepared so that a quote can be looked for in it."""
+
+    as_written: str
+    # The same text with whitespace collapsed, three ways: as written; the
+    # diff's new side; the diff's old side.
+    readings: tuple[str, str, str]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def of(cls, request: Request) -> SentData:
+        # First BEGIN marker to last END marker: a marker inside the data
+        # cannot shrink the region that is searched.
+        _, _, rest = request.prompt.partition(_BEGIN_DATA + "\n")
+        data, _, _ = rest.rpartition("\n" + _END_DATA)
+        lines = data.splitlines()
+        # A diff interleaves removed lines among added ones, so code quoted
+        # from either file is contiguous only once the other side's lines
+        # are dropped and the markers stripped. (`---` / `+++` are a file
+        # header's lines, not a removal or an addition.)
+        new_side = (
+            line[1:] if line[:1] in ("+", " ") else line
+            for line in lines
+            if not (line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"))
+        )
+        old_side = (
+            line[1:] if line[:1] in ("-", " ") else line
+            for line in lines
+            if not (line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"))
+        )
+        return cls(
+            as_written=data,
+            readings=(_squash(lines), _squash(new_side), _squash(old_side)),
+        )
+
+    def problem_with(self, quote: str) -> str | None:
+        """None when the quote is found in the data; otherwise why it is not

+        return None if any(wanted in reading for reading in self.readings) else "not found"

@pytest.mark.parametrize("quote", ["if criteria", "contract", ")", "   \n  "])
def test_sc2_an_excerpt_below_the_minimum_length_is_not_accepted(quote: str) -> None:
    """SC-2: too short to be evidence, even though it is in the data."""
    assert _sent().problem_with(quote) == "too short"


def test_sc2_the_data_searched_is_exactly_the_data_sent() -> None:
    """SC-2: the search is over the request's own data region."""
    request = build_request(_bundle())

    sent = SentData.of(request)

    assert f"===== BEGIN DATA =====\n{sent.as_written}\n===== END DATA =====" in request.prompt
    assert PR77_DIFF in sent.as_written and TEST_SOURCE in sent.as_written


# ---- SC-3: the 2026-11-09 case --------------------------------------------


async def test_sc3_the_false_finding_is_unsupported_and_there_is_no_verdict() -> None:
    """SC-3: two real quotes and one invented one — the judgment that
    carries only that finding is "could not judge", reason unsupported-finding."""
    registry, roster = _wire(_answer(True, THE_FALSE_FINDING))

    with pytest.raises(NoVerdictError) as raised:
        await judge(_bundle(), roster, registry=registry)

    assert raised.value.reason == "unsupported-finding"
    assert "PR-77" in str(raised.value)


def _run_cli(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path, name: str, response: Response
) -> int:
    """The gate's real CLI over a canned bundle and a canned model answer."""
    (tmp_path / "agent-framework.toml").write_text(
        f'[roles]\nvalidator = {{ provider = "{name}", model = "judge-9" }}\n', encoding="utf-8"
    )
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(gate_cli, "collect_bundle", lambda *a, **k: _bundle())
    register_provider(name, _Fake(response))
    return gate_cli.main(["77"])


def test_sc3_the_cli_reports_could_not_judge_and_exits_three(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    """SC-3: from the command line it is exit 3 with the reason — not the
    REJECT (exit 1) it was on 2026-11-09, and not a PASS."""
    code = _run_cli(monkeypatch, tmp_path, "fake-false-finding", _answer(True, THE_FALSE_FINDING))

    out, err = capsys.readouterr()
    assert code == 3
    printed = json.loads(out)
    assert printed["verdict"] == "none" and printed["reason"] == "unsupported-finding"
    assert "Traceback" not in err


# ---- SC-4: a REJECT carries only supported findings ------------------------


async def test_sc4_a_reject_carries_only_the_supported_finding() -> None:
    """SC-4: one supported and one unsupported finding — REJECT, with one."""
    registry, roster = _wire(_answer(True, THE_FALSE_FINDING, A_SUPPORTED_FINDING))

    verdict = await validate(_bundle(), roster, registry=registry)

    assert verdict == Reject(
        task_id="PR-77",

    padded = _finding(REAL_TABLE_CITATIONS, "if criteria")
    registry, roster = _wire(_answer(True, padded))

    with pytest.raises(NoVerdictError, match="unsupported-finding"):

# ---- SC-5: what was dropped is logged --------------------------------------


async def test_sc5_an_unsupported_finding_is_logged_with_the_quote_not_found(
    caplog: pytest.LogCaptureFixture,
) -> None:

async def test_sc5_it_is_logged_before_could_not_judge_is_raised(

    """SC-5 here: also when no finding is left and there is no verdict."""

# ---- SC-6: the model is told the rule --------------------------------------


def test_sc6_the_instructions_state_the_quote_rule() -> None:
    """SC-6: quotes are checked; only part of each changed file is shown;
    unseen code must not be quoted — said in the instructions, not the data."""
    prompt = build_request(_bundle()).prompt
    instructions = " ".join(prompt.split("===== BEGIN DATA =====")[0].split())

    assert (
        "Every quote in a finding is checked against that data by code, and a "
        "finding with a quote that is not found there, word for word, is discarded."
    ) in instructions
    assert (
        "The diff shows only part of each changed file, so do not quote or "
        "describe code you were not shown"
    ) in instructions
    # ...and the model is told what to do instead of guessing.
    assert "say so in the finding instead of guessing at that code" in instructions

async def test_sc7_a_no_defect_judgment_is_the_same_pass() -> None:

    verdict = await validate(_bundle(), roster, registry=registry)

def test_sc7_pass_and_reject_keep_their_codes_and_a_reject_its_keys(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    """SC-7: PASS exits 0, REJECT exits 1, and a REJECT's JSON has the keys
    it had — the quotes admit a finding, they are not part of the verdict."""
    assert _run_cli(monkeypatch, tmp_path, "fake-clean", _answer(False)) == 0
    assert json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)["verdict"] == "pass"

    code = _run_cli(monkeypatch, tmp_path, "fake-defect", _answer(True, A_SUPPORTED_FINDING))

    printed = json.loads(capsys.readouterr().out)

tests.tests/validator/test_judgment.py:
"""The judgment stage.

Verifies:
- SC-4: a defect reported through return_verdict is carried into the
  judgment verbatim (finding + evidence).
- SC-5: the request goes through the roster's `validator` role in an
  isolated registry, and the prompt carries the refutation checklist.
Plus the fail-loud paths: no tool call, malformed findings, and an
unevidenced defect all raise JudgmentFormatError.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest

from agent_framework.errors import JudgmentFormatError
from agent_framework.providers.base import Request, Response, ToolCall
from agent_framework.providers.registry import ProviderRegistry
from agent_framework.roster import Roster
from agent_framework.validator.bundle import CIEvidence, EvidenceBundle, TaskRef
from agent_framework.validator.judgment import REFUTATION_CHECKLIST, VERDICT_TOOL, judge
from agent_framework.validator.verdict import Finding


class _FakeProvider:
    """Records its calls and returns a canned Response."""

    def __init__(self, response: Response) -> None:
        self.response = response
        self.calls: list[tuple[Request, str]] = []

    async def invoke(self, request: Request, *, model: str) -> Response:
        self.calls.append((request, model))
        return self.response


def _roster() -> Roster:
    return Roster.from_dict(
        {"roles": {"validator": {"provider": "fake", "model": "judge-1"}}}
    )


def _bundle() -> EvidenceBundle:
    return EvidenceBundle(
        task=TaskRef(task_id="T-9", criteria=("SC-1", "SC-2")),
        diff="--- a/x.py\n+++ b/x.py\n+def f(): return 1",
        tests={"tests/test_x.py": '"""Cites SC-1, SC-2."""\ndef test_a(): ...'},
        ci=CIEvidence(green=True, summary="ci run 42: all green"),
    )


def _wire(response: Response) -> tuple[_FakeProvider, ProviderRegistry]:
    reg = ProviderRegistry()
    fake = _FakeProvider(response)
    reg.register("fake", fake)
    return fake, reg


def _verdict_response(arguments: dict[str, Any]) -> Response:
    return Response(text="", tool_calls=(ToolCall(VERDICT_TOOL.name, arguments),))


async def test_sc4_defect_from_return_verdict_is_carried_verbatim() -> None:
    """SC-4: the model's finding + evidence arrive in the Judgment untouched."""
    reported = {
        "defect_found": True,
        "findings": [
            {
                "check": "test-honesty",
                "finding": "test_a asserts nothing about f()",
                "evidence": "tests/test_x.py::test_a has no assert",
                # Admits the finding (specs/finding-evidence); not carried.
                "quotes": ["def test_a(): ..."],
            }
        ],
    }
    _, reg = _wire(_verdict_response(reported))

    judgment = await judge(_bundle(), _roster(), registry=reg)

    assert judgment.defect_found is True
    assert judgment.findings == (
        Finding(
            check="test-honesty",
            finding="test_a asserts nothing about f()",
            evidence="tests/test_x.py::test_a has no assert",
        ),
    )


async def test_sc5_judgment_dispatches_through_validator_role_with_checklist() -> None:
    """SC-5: roster's validator role is used; the prompt carries the refutation checklist."""
    fake, reg = _wire(_verdict_response({"defect_found": False, "findings": []}))

    judgment = await judge(_bundle(), _roster(), registry=reg)

    assert judgment.defect_found is False
    [(request, model)] = fake.calls
    assert model == "judge-1"  # resolved via the roster's validator binding
    assert REFUTATION_CHECKLIST in request.prompt
    assert request.tools == (VERDICT_TOOL,)  # exactly one tool: return_verdict


async def test_no_tool_call_raises_typed_error() -> None:
    _, reg = _wire(Response(text="LGTM, ship it"))
    with pytest.raises(JudgmentFormatError, match="did not call return_verdict"):
        await judge(_bundle(), _roster(), registry=reg)


async def test_defect_without_findings_raises_typed_error() -> None:
    _, reg = _wire(_verdict_response({"defect_found": True, "findings": []}))
    with pytest.raises(JudgmentFormatError, match="cite, don't assert"):
        await judge(_bundle(), _roster(), registry=reg)


async def test_malformed_finding_raises_typed_error() -> None:
    _, reg = _wire(
        _verdict_response({"defect_found": True, "findings": [{"check": "x"}]})
    )
    with pytest.raises(JudgmentFormatError, match="missing field"):
        await judge(_bundle(), _roster(), registry=reg)
